scope: Every file matching src/tests/** and src/**/__tests__/** with coverage taken from header comments, role and module matrices, risk register, and the v2.18.4 acceptance checklist.
recommendation: Run the full vitest suite as a required CI check on every pull request. Triage the 16 pre-existing failures in the next correction release so the CI gate starts from a green baseline.

roleMatrix.legend: Direct: tests pin the behavior for this role. Indirect: covered through shared helpers this role depends on. None: no test in the suite; guarded by route-level auth gates and lint. Blocked by design: the role is denied the capability and no test asserts the denial.

capabilityAreas.SUPER_ADMIN: Indirect (data layer is role-agnostic; routes gate)

roleMatrix.honestGaps: Route-level behavior (role gates, rate limits, 401/403 responses) is guarded by the in-route patterns and the static verification scripts, not by route integration tests in this repository. The rentals, eTIMS, M-Pesa callback, and user management areas have no dedicated test file.

moduleMatrix.notes: Link builder, domain helpers, cross-file consistency.

Pagination, rate limit tiers, error normalization, Zod schemas.

riskRegister.risk: 471 strict-typecheck errors on pre-existing lineage files (the documented baseline since the v2.18.3 reconciliation; CI runs Type Check as advisory).
riskRegister.status: Accepted baseline, not a v2.18.4 regression.
riskRegister.mitigation: v2.18.4 contributes zero new strict errors (gate below). Future releases chip away at the baseline; the advisory CI check keeps it visible.

riskRegister.risk: 16 pre-existing vitest failures (551 passed / 16 failed / 20 skipped at the v2.18.3 baseline).
riskRegister.status: Accepted baseline, not a v2.18.4 regression.
riskRegister.mitigation: Run the full vitest suite in CI so the count is enforced on every pull request.

riskRegister.risk: Route-level behavior (auth gates, rate limits, status codes) has no integration tests in the repository.
riskRegister.mitigation: Compensating controls: the uniform requireAuth/requireRole patterns, the static verify scripts, and lint. Route tests are the first candidate after the CI gate lands.

riskRegister.risk: computeBranchDiagnostics tests run against a mocked database; a real-database exercise happens later in CI (prepare-test-db) and on live deployments.
riskRegister.mitigation: The data layer degrades on every failure mode; the schema drift probe reports drift or unknown rather than throwing.

riskRegister.risk: Release verification in some environments cannot trust rendered terminal output for content patterns.
riskRegister.mitigation: Verification uses base64 encoding, YES/NO boolean checks, and git object-store reads in single processes.
